lines: A message from a researcher across the border suggests a correlation between Spoilage and poor air quality.
I can vouch for the credibility of this researcher, so please heed this call.

I know that a clean breath of air might be too much for this city, so the only thing I can recommend to all of you is to spend your free time on the rooftops, as the smog would be thinner there on some days.
I cannot say that this is the end-all, be-all solution, but we should do what we can to survive and live to fight another day in this city.
